description: Monitoring that runs on its own and posts changes to a webhook. Each kind takes action create (default), status or stop where it applies. Pick with mode: page = Watch one page (or a competitor page with competitor_of) for SEO changes. Needs url. page_status = Latest result of a page watch. Needs watch_id. page_stop = Stop a page watch. Needs watch_id. site_audit = Audit the whole site every 1, 7 or 30 days and alert on regressions. guard = Every 6 hours: robots.txt, sitemap, https, noindex and canonical on key pages, for deploy accidents. competitors = Weekly new, updated and removed pages from competitors' sitemaps, flagged by your topics.

pages.description: Key pages to guard besides the home page (money pages first).

topics.description: Your topics or keywords, to flag overlapping pages.

webhook_url.description: Optional https URL that receives a JSON POST when something changes, for example a Slack or Discord incoming webhook.

name: watch
title: Keep watching
